news.title: Borrowing off the floor
news.summary: Just my opinion/NFA. I have found borrowing against my stack with low LTV at a reputable lender to be an effective way fund necessary expenses. Also my opinion: we are at or near the bottom, not necessarily THE bottom (based on Power Law). So rather than sell, I have used intelligent leverage, and total loan duration for me is around 4 months.
